authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6835 dhūḍi/dhūli explicitly lists Bengali dhulā and Oriya dhuḷi “dust”. Reduplicated dhudhur forms need separate analysis of their additional material. Joint comparison: Hajong dʰula “dust” matches reviewed B dhula “dust” (f_5febdspr4nq6q). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.
